column3: NKJV adds the heading “THE BELOVED”; “your eyes are doves” is rendered “You have dove’s eyes.”
Close to the Hebrew; “shorn [ewes]” is rendered “shorn sheep.”
Close to the Hebrew; “slice” is rendered “piece.”
Close to the Hebrew; לְתַלְפִּיּוֹת (rare word, “courses” or “weapons”) is rendered “for an armory.”
Close to the Hebrew; “breathes” is rendered “breaks.”
Close to the Hebrew; “blemish” is rendered “spot.”
NKJV renders “come… come down” as “Come with me… Look from,” and “bride” “my spouse.”
Close to the Hebrew; “stolen my heart” is rendered “ravished my heart,” and “bride” “spouse.”
Close to the Hebrew; “your loves” is rendered “your love,” and “bride” “spouse.”
Close to the Hebrew; “honey drips” is rendered “Drip as the honeycomb.”
Close to the Hebrew; “locked” is rendered “enclosed… shut up,” and “bride” “spouse.”
Close to the Hebrew; “your shoots” is rendered “Your plants,” and “garden” “orchard.”
Close to the Hebrew; “flowing” is rendered “streams.”
NKJV adds the heading “THE SHULAMITE”; “choice fruit” is rendered “pleasant fruits.”
